summary: Phase 149O.12A -- Signed Evidence Model + Evidence Store Implementation: bounded production implementation phase (Wave A + Wave B of the 149O.11 plan only -- no signing ceremony, no CLI, no AG3/AG5 consumption wiring, no rollback/Permission Broker changes, no HATP production activation, no Class-B provisioning). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.11) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.11 completed/complete/pushed/consistent, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full HSCE-001 v1.1 contract text and the 149O.11 implementation plan's Sections 9-10/16 (envelope model and evidence store design) directly, plus the full existing production source (human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py's _write_atomic_json/write_creation_registration precedents, repository_identity.py, paths.py) to extract exact existing function/class names and conventions rather than inventing plausible-sounding ones. Implemented exactly two new production modules: src/pcae/core/hatp_signed_evidence.py (the frozen HATPSignedEvidenceEnvelope four-field model; a single shared _validate_envelope_fields function enforcing constructor/parser domain equivalence per the B-149O.1H-2 lesson; explicit isinstance(value, bool) pre-check before trusting evidence_version==1, mirroring _require_proof_version; shared validate_evidence_id regex validator exported for the store's reuse; evidence_id bound to digest_hatp_proof_payload(proof) and rechecked at every construction path; Base64 provider_assertion encoding only at the JSON boundary via strict base64.b64decode(validate=True); module-local duplicate-key-rejecting object_pairs_hook parser delegating nested proof parsing to the existing parse_hatp_proof rather than reimplementing it; canonical serializer per HSCE-REQ-053's exact UTF-8/sort_keys/allow_nan=False/default-separators specification) and src/pcae/core/hatp_evidence_store.py (HATPEvidenceStore with path_for/load/publish only -- no exists()/latest()/approve()-style method; symlink-escape checks for both the final destination and every .pcae/hatp-evidence/envelopes path component; the exact repaired HSCE-REQ-052 11-step exclusive hard-link publication algorithm: canonical-bytes-before-temp, same-directory tempfile.mkstemp, write+flush+fsync inside a with os.fdopen block whose exit closes the fd before any os.link attempt, os.path.islink pre-check, os.link attempt, winner path with best-effort temp cleanup, FileExistsError loser path re-checking symlink status then validating the existing object is a safe regular file via os.lstat+stat.S_ISREG before any byte comparison, byte-identical idempotent success vs. byte-differing evidence_conflict, and any other OSError failing closed as evidence_persistence_failure with zero fallback to os.replace or any other overwrite-capable primitive under any condition). Resolved the previously-open 149O.10.2-Obs-3 finding (loser-comparison read-failure error_type gap) as implemented behavior exactly per the 149O.11 plan's selected mapping: an unsafe existing-final-object (directory, FIFO, socket, unreadable file) at the destination fails closed as evidence_persistence_failure, never evidence_conflict -- independently exercised by dedicated tests for each unsafe-object category. Wrote 176 new tests across three files (84 in tests/test_hatp_signed_evidence.py covering constructor/parser equivalence, version bool-rejection, 15-case evidence-ID-validation parametrization, digest binding, Base64 strictness, closed-schema/duplicate-key/wrong-type attacks, canonical round-trip and noncanonical-input canonicalization, content-addressing precision; 48 in tests/test_hatp_evidence_store.py covering path traversal, symlink safety for the final path and all three store-root path components, the Obs-3 object-type checks, real-filesystem concurrency including 2/8/16-writer identical and differing races plus a mixed-race and a 5-iteration stability re-run, fault-injected EXDEV/EPERM/ENOTSUP/fsync-failure/write-failure non-EEXIST os.link error paths with an explicit spy confirming no fallback to os.replace, temp-file lifecycle cleanup across all three outcomes, and a dynamic instrumentation test proving the writable temp file descriptor is already closed by the time os.link is invoked; 44 in tests/test_phase_149o_12a_signed_evidence_model_store_implementation.py covering a git-derived production-file-allowlist check robust across untracked/staged/committed states, HSCE-001/HATP-001/RAE-001 byte-identity checks against the 149O.11 baseline commit, no-scope-creep checks for CLI/signing-ceremony/existing-HATP-module/PB/hardware-import absence, no-authority-bearing-field field-set assertions, os.link-present/os.replace-absent static source checks, and a required-attack-subset presence check). Widened one existing semantic production-file-allowlist test (test_phase_149o_1g_..._only_expected_production_files_changed) to name this phase's two new files, applying the retained 149O.5-F-3 lesson exactly as the 149O.11 plan itself instructed for an intentional new-HATP-module addition, rather than treating the resulting failure as a violation. Ran and reconfirmed non-regression: the combined 149O.9/149O.10/149O.10.1/149O.10.2 contract suites (198 passed, matching the reproducible current baselines, not the historical stale 89-count claim for 149O.10); the RAE contract/models/persistence/validation suites' 34 (of a 93-test bounded rollback/Permission-Broker sweep) pre-existing failures independently reconfirmed byte-identical via a git-stash-based clean-baseline comparison run, an Invalid-isoformat-string defect in rollback_approval_evidence.py wholly unrelated to and unimported by either of this phase's new modules; the report-trust suite (162 passed); and Fast Green (4784 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, after newly registering this phase's two deterministic real-filesystem-only test modules in tests/conftest.py::FAST_GREEN_MODULES -- not claimed byte-identical to the entering 4590-baseline, since this phase intentionally adds 132 new Fast-Green-eligible tests, but zero failures, the only non-regression claim actually made). VERDICT: HATP SIGNED EVIDENCE MODEL + EVIDENCE STORE: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR 149O.12B. Not a claim of full HSCE-001 implementation -- only Waves A+B of the six-wave 149O.11 decomposition; Waves C-F (proof-context resolution, signing orchestration, CLI, integrated attack-matrix suite) remain unimplemented, scheduled for 149O.12B and 149O.12C. No CLI implemented, no hardware touched, no signing occurred, no .pcae/hatp-evidence/ production directory created by this phase's own code. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, and RAE-001 v1.0 all remain byte-unchanged by this phase. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_12A_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_MODEL_EVIDENCE_STORE_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.12B, HATP Signing Ceremony Resolver + Orchestrator Implementation.

validation_results.name: exclusive_hard_link_algorithm_implemented_to_exact_spec
validation_results.result: publish() implements HSCE-REQ-052's repaired 11-step algorithm exactly: canonical-bytes-before-temp, same-directory tempfile.mkstemp, write+fsync+close-before-link, os.path.islink pre-check, os.link attempt, winner/loser/other-OSError branches, safe-object-type validation before loser comparison, unconditional temp cleanup. validation_results.name: close_before_link_fd_safety_confirmed
validation_results.result: Dynamic instrumentation test (test_write_descriptor_closed_before_link_is_attempted) wraps os.fdopen and os.link, captures the temp fd, and confirms from inside the wrapped os.link call that a write through that fd already raises OSError -- the writable descriptor is closed before os.link is ever invoked. Independently corroborated by a static source-ordering check.

validation_results.name: real_filesystem_concurrency_races_exactly_one_winner
